Listen first, then match the reference g.ar: استمع أولًا، ثم طابق النغمة المرجعية برفق. تساعد سماعات الرأس على منع وصول نغمة مكبر الصوت إلى الميكروفون.

Listen first, then match the reference g.zh-Hans: 先聆听参考音，再轻柔地将音高与它匹配。使用耳机可防止扬声器的参考音进入麦克风。

BrassTune uses account and practice data.ar: يستخدم BrassTune بيانات الحساب والتدريب لتقديم ملاحظات ضبط النغمة وحفظ التقدم.
BrassTune uses account and practice data.de: BrassTune verwendet Konto- und Übungsdaten, um Feedback zur Stimmung zu geben und Fortschritte zu speichern.
BrassTune uses account and practice data.es: BrassTune utiliza datos de la cuenta y de práctica para ofrecer comentarios de afinación y guardar el progreso.
BrassTune uses account and practice data.fr: BrassTune utilise les données du compte et des séances pour fournir un retour d’accordage et enregistrer la progression.
BrassTune uses account and practice data.ja: BrassTune はアカウントと練習のデータを使い、チューニングのフィードバックを提供して進捗を保存します。
BrassTune uses account and practice data.ko: BrassTune은 계정 및 연습 데이터를 사용해 튜닝 피드백을 제공하고 진행 상황을 저장합니다.
BrassTune uses account and practice data.pt-BR: O BrassTune usa dados da conta e de prática para fornecer feedback de afinação e salvar o progresso.
BrassTune uses account and practice data.ru: BrassTune использует данные учётной записи и занятий, чтобы давать обратную связь по настройке и сохранять прогресс.
BrassTune uses account and practice data.vi: BrassTune sử dụng dữ liệu tài khoản và luyện tập để cung cấp phản hồi về chỉnh cao độ và lưu tiến độ.
BrassTune uses account and practice data.zh-Hans: BrassTune 使用账户和练习数据提供调音反馈并保存进度。
BrassTune uses account and practice data.zh-Hant: BrassTune 使用帳戶和練習資料提供調音回饋並儲存進度。
BrassTune uses account and practice data.en: BrassTune uses account and practice data to provide tuning feedback and saved progress.

Practice recordings and imported sheet m.ar: تبقى تسجيلات التدريب والنوتات الموسيقية المستوردة على هذا الجهاز ما لم تختر مشاركتها أو تصديرها.
Practice recordings and imported sheet m.de: Übungsaufnahmen und importierte Noten bleiben auf diesem Gerät, sofern Sie sie nicht teilen oder exportieren.
Practice recordings and imported sheet m.es: Las grabaciones de práctica y las partituras importadas permanecen en este dispositivo, salvo que decidas compartirlas o exportarlas.
Practice recordings and imported sheet m.fr: Les enregistrements de séance et les partitions importées restent sur cet appareil, sauf si vous choisissez de les partager ou de les exporter.
Practice recordings and imported sheet m.ja: 練習の録音と取り込んだ楽譜は、共有または書き出しを選ばない限り、この端末に保存されます。
Practice recordings and imported sheet m.ko: 연습 녹음과 가져온 악보는 공유하거나 내보내기를 선택하지 않는 한 이 기기에 보관됩니다.
Practice recordings and imported sheet m.pt-BR: As gravações de prática e as partituras importadas ficam neste dispositivo, a menos que você escolha compartilhá-las ou exportá-las.
Practice recordings and imported sheet m.ru: Записи занятий и импортированные ноты остаются на этом устройстве, если вы не решите поделиться ими или экспортировать их.
Practice recordings and imported sheet m.vi: Bản ghi âm luyện tập và bản nhạc đã nhập sẽ được giữ trên thiết bị này trừ khi bạn chọn chia sẻ hoặc xuất chúng.
Practice recordings and imported sheet m.zh-Hans: 练习录音和导入的乐谱会保留在此设备上，除非你选择共享或导出。
Practice recordings and imported sheet m.zh-Hant: 練習錄音和匯入的樂譜會保留在此裝置上，除非你選擇分享或匯出。
Practice recordings and imported sheet m.en: Practice recordings and imported sheet music stay on this device unless you choose to share or export them.

Use BrassTune only with consent and with.ar: استخدم BrassTune فقط بموافقة ووفق سياسات المدرسة أو الاستوديو أو المؤسسة التي توفر إمكانية الوصول.
Use BrassTune only with consent and with.de: Verwenden Sie BrassTune nur mit Einwilligung und gemäß den Richtlinien der Schule, des Studios oder der Organisation, die den Zugang bereitstellt.
Use BrassTune only with consent and with.es: Usa BrassTune solo con consentimiento y conforme a las políticas de la escuela, el estudio o la organización que proporciona el acceso.
Use BrassTune only with consent and with.fr: Utilisez BrassTune uniquement avec consentement et dans le respect des règles de l’école, du studio ou de l’organisation qui fournit l’accès.
Use BrassTune only with consent and with.ja: BrassTune は同意を得た上で、アクセスを提供する学校、教室、組織のポリシーに従って使用してください。
Use BrassTune only with consent and with.ko: BrassTune은 동의를 받고 접근 권한을 제공하는 학교, 스튜디오 또는 기관의 정책 범위 내에서만 사용하세요.
Use BrassTune only with consent and with.pt-BR: Use o BrassTune somente com consentimento e de acordo com as políticas da escola, estúdio ou organização que fornece o acesso.
Use BrassTune only with consent and with.ru: Используйте BrassTune только с согласия и в рамках правил школы, студии или организации, предоставляющей доступ.
Use BrassTune only with consent and with.vi: Chỉ sử dụng BrassTune khi có sự đồng ý và theo chính sách của trường, phòng tập hoặc tổ chức cung cấp quyền truy cập.
Use BrassTune only with consent and with.zh-Hans: 仅在获得同意并遵守提供访问权限的学校、工作室或组织政策的情况下使用 BrassTune。
Use BrassTune only with consent and with.zh-Hant: 僅在獲得同意並遵守提供存取權限的學校、工作室或組織政策的情況下使用 BrassTune。
Use BrassTune only with consent and with.en: Use BrassTune only with consent and within the policies of the school, studio, or organization providing access.

BrassTune is practice analytics software.ar: BrassTune برنامج لتحليل التدريب ولا يحل محل التعليم أو إرشادات سلامة السمع.
BrassTune is practice analytics software.de: BrassTune ist eine Software zur Übungsanalyse und ersetzt weder Unterricht noch Hinweise zum Gehörschutz.
BrassTune is practice analytics software.es: BrassTune es un software de análisis de práctica y no sustituye la enseñanza ni las recomendaciones de seguridad auditiva.
BrassTune is practice analytics software.fr: BrassTune est un logiciel d’analyse des séances et ne remplace ni l’enseignement ni les conseils de protection auditive.
BrassTune is practice analytics software.ja: BrassTune は練習分析ソフトウェアであり、指導や聴覚保護に関する助言の代わりにはなりません。
BrassTune is practice analytics software.ko: BrassTune은 연습 분석 소프트웨어이며 지도나 청력 보호 안내를 대신하지 않습니다.
BrassTune is practice analytics software.pt-BR: O BrassTune é um software de análise de prática e não substitui instrução nem orientação sobre segurança auditiva.
BrassTune is practice analytics software.ru: BrassTune — это программа для анализа занятий, она не заменяет обучение или рекомендации по защите слуха.
BrassTune is practice analytics software.vi: BrassTune là phần mềm phân tích luyện tập, không thay thế việc giảng dạy hoặc hướng dẫn bảo vệ thính giác.
BrassTune is practice analytics software.zh-Hans: BrassTune 是练习分析软件，不能替代教学或听力安全指导。
BrassTune is practice analytics software.zh-Hant: BrassTune 是練習分析軟體，不能取代教學或聽力安全指導。
BrassTune is practice analytics software.en: BrassTune is practice analytics software and does not replace instruction or hearing-safety guidance.

Contact the teacher, director, or organi.ar: تواصل مع المعلم أو المدير أو المؤسسة التي وفرت لك إمكانية الوصول إلى BrassTune.
Contact the teacher, director, or organi.de: Wenden Sie sich an die Lehrkraft, Leitung oder Organisation, die den Zugang zu BrassTune bereitgestellt hat.
Contact the teacher, director, or organi.es: Contacta al profesor, director u organización que proporcionó acceso a BrassTune.
Contact the teacher, director, or organi.fr: Contactez l’enseignant, le directeur ou l’organisation qui vous a donné accès à BrassTune.
Contact the teacher, director, or organi.ja: BrassTune へのアクセスを提供した先生、指揮者、または組織に連絡してください。
Contact the teacher, director, or organi.ko: BrassTune 접근 권한을 제공한 교사, 지휘자 또는 기관에 문의하세요.
Contact the teacher, director, or organi.pt-BR: Entre em contato com o professor, diretor ou organização que forneceu acesso ao BrassTune.
Contact the teacher, director, or organi.ru: Свяжитесь с педагогом, руководителем или организацией, предоставившей доступ к BrassTune.
Contact the teacher, director, or organi.vi: Liên hệ giáo viên, nhạc trưởng hoặc tổ chức đã cung cấp quyền truy cập BrassTune.
Contact the teacher, director, or organi.zh-Hans: 请联系为你提供 BrassTune 访问权限的教师、指挥或组织。
Contact the teacher, director, or organi.zh-Hant: 請聯絡為你提供 BrassTune 存取權限的教師、指揮或組織。
Contact the teacher, director, or organi.en: Contact the teacher, director, or organization that provided BrassTune access.

Tell them what you were doing, which scr.ar: أخبرهم بما كنت تفعله والشاشة التي كنت عليها والوقت التقريبي لحدوث المشكلة.
Tell them what you were doing, which scr.de: Teilen Sie mit, was Sie getan haben, auf welchem Bildschirm Sie waren und ungefähr wann das Problem auftrat.
Tell them what you were doing, which scr.es: Indícales qué estabas haciendo, en qué pantalla estabas y aproximadamente cuándo ocurrió el problema.
Tell them what you were doing, which scr.fr: Indiquez ce que vous faisiez, l’écran affiché et l’heure approximative à laquelle le problème est survenu.
Tell them what you were doing, which scr.ja: 行っていた操作、表示していた画面、問題が起きたおおよその時刻を伝えてください。
Tell them what you were doing, which scr.ko: 무엇을 하고 있었는지, 어느 화면이었는지, 문제가 대략 언제 발생했는지 알려 주세요.
Tell them what you were doing, which scr.pt-BR: Informe o que você estava fazendo, em qual tela estava e aproximadamente quando o problema aconteceu.
Tell them what you were doing, which scr.ru: Сообщите, что вы делали, на каком экране находились и примерно когда возникла проблема.
Tell them what you were doing, which scr.vi: Hãy cho họ biết bạn đang làm gì, đang ở màn hình nào và sự cố xảy ra vào khoảng thời gian nào.
Tell them what you were doing, which scr.zh-Hans: 请告诉他们你当时在做什么、处于哪个界面，以及问题大约何时发生。
Tell them what you were doing, which scr.zh-Hant: 請告訴他們你當時在做什麼、處於哪個畫面，以及問題大約何時發生。
Tell them what you were doing, which scr.en: Tell them what you were doing, which screen you were on, and about when the problem happened.

Breathe in quietly for 4 counts and rele.ar: استنشق بهدوء لأربع عدات وأطلق النفس لثماني عدات. أبقِ كتفيك مسترخيين.
Breathe in quietly for 4 counts and rele.de: Atmen Sie vier Schläge lang leise ein und acht Schläge lang aus. Halten Sie die Schultern locker.
Breathe in quietly for 4 counts and rele.es: Inhala en silencio durante 4 tiempos y suelta el aire durante 8. Mantén los hombros relajados.
Breathe in quietly for 4 counts and rele.fr: Inspirez silencieusement pendant 4 temps et expirez pendant 8. Gardez les épaules détendues.
Breathe in quietly for 4 counts and rele.ja: 4拍で静かに息を吸い、8拍で吐きます。肩の力を抜きましょう。
Breathe in quietly for 4 counts and rele.ko: 4박 동안 조용히 들이마시고 8박 동안 내쉬세요. 어깨에 힘을 빼세요.
Breathe in quietly for 4 counts and rele.pt-BR: Inspire em silêncio por 4 tempos e solte o ar por 8. Mantenha os ombros relaxados.
Breathe in quietly for 4 counts and rele.ru: Тихо вдохните на 4 счёта и выдохните на 8. Держите плечи расслабленными.
Breathe in quietly for 4 counts and rele.vi: Hít vào nhẹ nhàng trong 4 phách và thở ra trong 8 phách. Giữ vai thả lỏng.
Breathe in quietly for 4 counts and rele.zh-Hans: 用 4 拍安静地吸气，再用 8 拍呼气。保持肩膀放松。
Breathe in quietly for 4 counts and rele.zh-Hant: 用 4 拍安靜地吸氣，再用 8 拍呼氣。保持肩膀放鬆。
Breathe in quietly for 4 counts and rele.en: Breathe in quietly for 4 counts and release for 8. Keep shoulders loose.

Buzz a comfortable pitch softly. Rest wh.ar: أصدر طنينًا ناعمًا على طبقة مريحة. استرح كلما شعرت بأن الصوت مجهد.
Buzz a comfortable pitch softly. Rest wh.de: Summen Sie leise auf einer angenehmen Tonhöhe. Machen Sie Pause, sobald der Ton erzwungen wirkt.
Buzz a comfortable pitch softly. Rest wh.es: Haz un zumbido suave en una altura cómoda. Descansa cuando el sonido se sienta forzado.
Buzz a comfortable pitch softly. Rest wh.fr: Faites doucement vibrer les lèvres sur une hauteur confortable. Reposez-vous dès que le son semble forcé.
Buzz a comfortable pitch softly. Rest wh.ja: 無理のない音程でやさしくバズィングします。音に力みを感じたら休みましょう。
Buzz a comfortable pitch softly. Rest wh.ko: 편안한 음정으로 부드럽게 버징하세요. 소리가 억지로 나는 느낌이 들면 쉬세요.
Buzz a comfortable pitch softly. Rest wh.pt-BR: Faça um buzz suave em uma altura confortável. Descanse sempre que o som parecer forçado.
Buzz a comfortable pitch softly. Rest wh.ru: Мягко пожужжите губами на удобной высоте. Отдохните, если звук появляется с напряжением.
Buzz a comfortable pitch softly. Rest wh.vi: Rung môi nhẹ ở cao độ thoải mái. Nghỉ bất cứ khi nào âm thanh có vẻ gượng ép.
Buzz a comfortable pitch softly. Rest wh.zh-Hans: 在舒适的音高上轻柔地震唇。只要感到发音勉强，就停下休息。
Buzz a comfortable pitch softly. Rest wh.zh-Hant: 在舒適的音高上輕柔地震唇。只要感到發音勉強，就停下休息。
Buzz a comfortable pitch softly. Rest wh.en: Buzz a comfortable pitch softly. Rest whenever the sound feels forced.

Play an easy note with a smooth start an.ar: اعزف نغمة مريحة ببداية ناعمة وهواء ثابت.
Play an easy note with a smooth start an.de: Spielen Sie eine leichte Note mit weichem Einsatz und gleichmäßiger Luft.
Play an easy note with a smooth start an.es: Toca una nota cómoda con un inicio suave y aire constante.
Play an easy note with a smooth start an.fr: Jouez une note facile avec une attaque douce et un souffle régulier.
Play an easy note with a smooth start an.ja: 無理のない音を、なめらかに立ち上げ、安定した息で演奏します。
Play an easy note with a smooth start an.ko: 부드럽게 시작하고 일정한 숨을 유지하며 편안한 음을 연주하세요.
Play an easy note with a smooth start an.pt-BR: Toque uma nota confortável com início suave e ar constante.
Play an easy note with a smooth start an.ru: Сыграйте удобную ноту с мягким началом и ровным потоком воздуха.
Play an easy note with a smooth start an.vi: Chơi một nốt dễ với phần vào âm êm và luồng hơi đều.
Play an easy note with a smooth start an.zh-Hans: 以平滑的起音和稳定的气息演奏一个舒适的音符。
Play an easy note with a smooth start an.zh-Hant: 以平滑的起音和穩定的氣息演奏一個舒適的音符。
Play an easy note with a smooth start an.en: Play an easy note with a smooth start and steady air.

Move between two comfortable notes witho.ar: تنقل بين نغمتين مريحتين من دون الضغط على قطعة الفم.
Move between two comfortable notes witho.de: Wechseln Sie zwischen zwei angenehmen Noten, ohne das Mundstück anzudrücken.
Move between two comfortable notes witho.es: Pasa entre dos notas cómodas sin presionar la boquilla.
Move between two comfortable notes witho.fr: Passez entre deux notes confortables sans appuyer sur l’embouchure.
Move between two comfortable notes witho.ja: マウスピースを押し付けずに、無理のない2つの音を行き来します。
Move between two comfortable notes witho.ko: 마우스피스를 누르지 않고 편안한 두 음 사이를 이동하세요.
Move between two comfortable notes witho.pt-BR: Alterne entre duas notas confortáveis sem pressionar o bocal.
Move between two comfortable notes witho.ru: Переходите между двумя удобными нотами, не давя на мундштук.
Move between two comfortable notes witho.vi: Chuyển giữa hai nốt thoải mái mà không ấn miếng ngậm.
Move between two comfortable notes witho.zh-Hans: 在两个舒适的音符之间连奏，不要压紧吹嘴。
Move between two comfortable notes witho.zh-Hant: 在兩個舒適的音符之間連奏，不要壓緊吹嘴。
Move between two comfortable notes witho.en: Move between two comfortable notes without pressing the mouthpiece.

Finish with one slow scale at an even vo.ar: اختتم بعزف سلم موسيقي بطيء واحد بمستوى صوت متساوٍ.
Finish with one slow scale at an even vo.de: Schließen Sie mit einer langsamen Tonleiter bei gleichmäßiger Lautstärke ab.
Finish with one slow scale at an even vo.es: Termina con una escala lenta a un volumen uniforme.
Finish with one slow scale at an even vo.fr: Terminez par une gamme lente à volume régulier.
Finish with one slow scale at an even vo.ja: 一定の音量でゆっくりと音階を1回演奏して終えます。
Finish with one slow scale at an even vo.ko: 일정한 음량으로 천천히 음계를 한 번 연주하며 마무리하세요.
Finish with one slow scale at an even vo.pt-BR: Termine com uma escala lenta em volume uniforme.
Finish with one slow scale at an even vo.ru: Завершите одной медленной гаммой с ровной громкостью.
Finish with one slow scale at an even vo.vi: Kết thúc bằng một gam chậm với âm lượng đều.
Finish with one slow scale at an even vo.zh-Hans: 最后以均匀音量慢速演奏一遍音阶。
Finish with one slow scale at an even vo.zh-Hant: 最後以均勻音量慢速演奏一遍音階。
Finish with one slow scale at an even vo.en: Finish with one slow scale at an even volume.

Take relaxed four-count breaths..ar: خذ أنفاسًا مسترخية من أربع عدات.
Take relaxed four-count breaths..de: Atmen Sie entspannt über vier Schläge.
Take relaxed four-count breaths..es: Respira de forma relajada durante cuatro tiempos.
Take relaxed four-count breaths..fr: Respirez de façon détendue sur quatre temps.
Take relaxed four-count breaths..ja: 4拍でリラックスして呼吸します。
Take relaxed four-count breaths..pt-BR: Respire de forma relaxada por quatro tempos.
Take relaxed four-count breaths..ru: Делайте расслабленные вдохи на четыре счёта.
Take relaxed four-count breaths..vi: Hít thở thư giãn trong bốn phách.

Play each highlighted note with steady a.ar: اعزف كل نغمة مميزة بهواء ثابت.
Play each highlighted note with steady a.de: Spielen Sie jede hervorgehobene Note mit gleichmäßiger Luft.
Play each highlighted note with steady a.es: Toca cada nota resaltada con aire constante.
Play each highlighted note with steady a.fr: Jouez chaque note en surbrillance avec un souffle régulier.
Play each highlighted note with steady a.ja: ハイライトされた各音を安定した息で演奏します。
Play each highlighted note with steady a.ko: 강조 표시된 각 음을 일정한 숨으로 연주하세요.
Play each highlighted note with steady a.pt-BR: Toque cada nota destacada com ar constante.
Play each highlighted note with steady a.ru: Сыграйте каждую выделенную ноту с ровным потоком воздуха.
Play each highlighted note with steady a.vi: Chơi từng nốt được tô sáng với luồng hơi đều.
Play each highlighted note with steady a.zh-Hans: 用稳定的气息演奏每个高亮音符。
Play each highlighted note with steady a.zh-Hant: 用穩定的氣息演奏每個高亮音符。
Play each highlighted note with steady a.en: Play each highlighted note with steady air.

Play comfortable notes with the click..ar: اعزف نغمات مريحة مع نقرات المسرع.
Play comfortable notes with the click..de: Spielen Sie angenehme Noten zum Metronomklick.
Play comfortable notes with the click..es: Toca notas cómodas con el clic del metrónomo.
Play comfortable notes with the click..fr: Jouez des notes confortables avec le clic du métronome.
Play comfortable notes with the click..ja: メトロノームのクリックに合わせて、無理のない音を演奏します。
Play comfortable notes with the click..ko: 메트로놈 클릭에 맞춰 편안한 음을 연주하세요.
Play comfortable notes with the click..pt-BR: Toque notas confortáveis com o clique do metrônomo.
Play comfortable notes with the click..ru: Играйте удобные ноты под щелчки метронома.
Play comfortable notes with the click..vi: Chơi các nốt thoải mái theo tiếng nhịp.
